host_policy.preflight_host: Recorded separately; not required to be the collection host. Preflight timings never enter scientific timing comparisons.
host_policy.collection_host: Choose, record and publish one stable collection timing environment before any experimental worker invocation, including GAC/root diagnostics. The environment must remain unchanged across all volumes, batches, configurations and five epochs.
freeze: stable reserved hardware/VM asset identity and reservation evidence
kernel/OS, affinity set and selected CPU
compiler path, version, hash and build flags
Python executable and version, NumPy and zlib versions
resource limits and timing-relevant environment variables
original and revised experiment-layer source hashes
host_policy.on_change: Pause before further worker calls. Do not pool heterogeneous-host timings or normalize them afterward. Any restart or new timing cohort requires a separately published prospective decision.
host_policy.current_environment_status: unselected; workspace has moved between node identities and CPU models; no stable reservation has been established

selection_policy.unit: Complete declared volume stages or the explicitly declared physical-anchor stage; whole frozen jobs and palette pairs only.
selection_policy.source: Read the original 72,148-ID manifest and archives. Preserve every record, ID, query, membership and byte; selection index stores archive path, data-record ordinal and original raw-record SHA-256.
selection_policy.volume_ownership: Use each frozen record's n and its matching manifest job n. Structured recipes retain their declared N. All four physical anchors are N=8 and remain a distinct anchors stage.
selection_policy.volume_selector_8: Includes both the N=8 anchor stage and ordinary N=8 volume stage. The stage selector may select the anchors stage separately without assigning it to N=4 or N=6.
selection_policy.ordering: Preserve v1 anchors-first stage order, five epochs per stage, H job/case order, palette order, mode rotation, API/query order and fresh process rules. A subset may read already sealed prerequisite stages but must never execute them implicitly.
selection_policy.resume: One shared study identity, administrative cost ledger, reference cache, agreement index and raw job directory across batches. Verify prior and selected job hashes/context/call IDs; reject missing prerequisites, changed scopes, foreign records and interrupted artifacts. No automatic reruns.
selection_policy.scientific_changes: None: cases, seeds, masks, truths, observations, cameras, configurations, budgets, weighting, references, solver binary and branching policy are unchanged.

unresolved_stage_order_conflict.original_rule: Ascending N; legacy physical anchors first, then declared camera/structured slots at each N. Complete all five epochs of a volume before the next, unless a predeclared stop pauses the study.
unresolved_stage_order_conflict.resolution_in_this_checkpoint: Do not amend stage order or reassign anchors. The N=4/6-only scoped launch rejects absent anchor prerequisites before any worker starts.
unresolved_stage_order_conflict.minimum_next_decision: On a stable frozen timing environment, separately authorize the original four-anchor stage first, or explicitly preregister deferral of that stage before the first timing call. This checkpoint authorizes neither.
